provider: ServaRICA Polar Bear / Killer Whale / Mammoth storage

free_tier.stated: Opossum 1 1 TB $29/yr · Polar Bear 2 TB $5/mo or $48/yr · Killer Whale 3.5 TB $8.50/mo or $84/yr · Mammoth 8 TB $20/mo or $220/yr

egress.terms: Quoted as a hard monthly transfer figure per plan: 4 TB / 12 TB / 18 TB / 24 TB on a 1 Gbps port. So 2-3x storage per month. ServaRICA's separate 'unlimited' offer is a different product line: unlimited transfer starting at 250 Mbps and growing +1 Mbps/day up to 1 Gbps.

interface_detail: KVM/Xen + root, so anything: SFTP, rsync, NFS, rclone serve s3, MinIO, WebDAV via container
tooling: Root access makes this the most chainable option in the dossier — you can run AList, MinIO, or a Cloudflare tunnel endpoint on the box itself.
chaining: composition with the pool is unestablished
limits_note: Bandwidth is a hard counter on these plans. Capacity grows +1 GB/day on the 'expanding' line. Billing/ordering was offline during my check (see reliability note).
